name: Adobe InDesign API
description: InDesign automation for Adobe Firefly Services (image.adobe.io): an InDesignPort + adapter for data merge (template + data source), layout rendering, and PDF export over the adobe-firefly-core foundation. Async.

questions.prompt: Which InDesign operations will you use?
Default output format? (exportPdf is always PDF)

checklist: Confirm the InDesign API entitlement + scope on your Adobe Developer Console project (same IMS Server-to-Server auth as Firefly)
Verify the current endpoints/payloads against Adobe docs — the InDesign API lives on image.adobe.io (same host family as Photoshop/Lightroom/Illustrator; the client posts absolute URLs there)
Provide presigned template (.indd) + output hrefs (and a data source for dataMerge) — use core passthrough or install an adobe-firefly-storage-* addon
Template + data-source merge: dataMerge maps records into a published InDesign template; default output format is ADOBE_INDESIGN_FORMAT (set at install), exportPdf is always PDF
